flag-dannebrog-lyndanisse.research_focus: the legend of the Dannebrog at the Battle of Lyndanisse in Estonia, 1219, and Danish crusader armour
flag-dannebrog-lyndanisse.scene: Mailed crusaders on a hillside battlefield look up as a banner with a plain cross drifts down out of a break in storm clouds, one knight reaching up to catch it.

flag-first-union-flag.research_focus: early Jacobean merchant and naval ships flying the first Union Flag, combining the crosses of St George and St Andrew
flag-first-union-flag.scene: A Jacobean sailing ship at sea flies a new jack at its bow, an upright cross laid over a diagonal one, sailors on deck looking up at it.

flag-grand-union-raised.research_focus: the Continental Navy ship Alfred at Philadelphia in December 1775 and the Grand Union Flag
flag-grand-union-raised.scene: A naval officer in a tricorne hauls a striped ensign with crossed crosses in its corner up the mast of a converted merchant warship on a wintry river.

flag-stars-stripes-adopted.research_focus: the 1777 Flag Resolution of the Continental Congress and early hand-sewn thirteen-star flags
flag-stars-stripes-adopted.scene: In a candlelit workroom, a seamstress in eighteenth-century dress spreads a newly sewn striped flag with a ring of stars in its canton across a long table.

flag-french-tricolour-adopted.research_focus: the French Republic's naval tricolour decree of 1794 and revolutionary sailors and soldiers
flag-french-tricolour-adopted.scene: A revolutionary soldier in a bicorne lifts a flag of three upright bands on its staff above a cheering crowd of citizens in liberty caps.

flag-italian-tricolore-first.research_focus: the Cispadane Republic's congress at Reggio Emilia in January 1797 and its banner
flag-italian-tricolore-first.scene: Delegates in late eighteenth-century coats rise in a vaulted hall as a three-band banner is unfurled from a gallery above them.

flag-union-flag-st-patrick.research_focus: the new Union Flag of 1 January 1801 flown on British public buildings and warships
flag-union-flag-st-patrick.scene: On a winter morning, a flag combining an upright cross with two overlapping diagonal crosses is hoisted on a staff above a Georgian stone building, a crowd in greatcoats watching.

flag-argentina-belgrano.research_focus: Manuel Belgrano raising the flag at the Rosario batteries on the Paraná River in February 1812
flag-argentina-belgrano.scene: On a riverbank battery, a general in a cocked hat raises a flag of three horizontal bands before ranks of soldiers in a hushed salute, the wide river behind them.

flag-greece-adopted.research_focus: the First National Assembly at Epidaurus in 1822 and Greek revolutionary fighters in fustanella
flag-greece-adopted.scene: Greek fighters in fustanellas and sashes plant a striped flag with a cross in its corner on a rocky hilltop above the sea.

flag-irish-tricolour-presented.research_focus: Thomas Francis Meagher presenting the tricolour in Dublin in 1848, a gift from French sympathisers
flag-irish-tricolour-presented.scene: A young orator in an 1840s frock coat holds up a silk flag of three upright bands from a balcony to a crowd gathered in a Dublin street.

flag-japan-hinomaru-decreed.research_focus: Meiji-era Japanese merchant steamships and harbours around 1870
flag-japan-hinomaru-decreed.scene: A Meiji-era steamship in a Japanese harbour flies a plain flag with a single disc at its centre, with no rays, sailors in mixed Western and Japanese dress on the deck.

flag-brazil-green-gold.research_focus: Rio de Janeiro in November 1889 and the new flag of the Brazilian Republic
flag-brazil-green-gold.scene: Soldiers and citizens in a Rio de Janeiro square raise a flag with a diamond and a starry globe crossed by a band, the band left blank, mountains behind the rooftops.

flag-philippines-unfurled.research_focus: the Aguinaldo house at Kawit, Cavite, and the proclamation of 12 June 1898
flag-philippines-unfurled.scene: From the carved wooden window of a large colonial mansion, a flag with a triangle bearing a sun and three stars is unfurled over a crowd in the courtyard below.

flag-australia-first-flown.research_focus: the Royal Exhibition Building in Melbourne in September 1901 and the new federal flag
flag-australia-first-flown.scene: A huge flag with the Southern Cross and a seven-pointed star is raised on a tall pole above the dome of a grand Melbourne exhibition hall, Edwardian crowds below.

flag-thailand-tricolour-adopted.research_focus: Siam in 1917, the elephant flag and the new Trairanga flag at a Bangkok palace
flag-thailand-tricolour-adopted.scene: Before a gilded Bangkok palace roof, an old banner bearing an elephant is lowered while a new flag of horizontal bands rises on the same pole.

flag-germany-black-red-gold.research_focus: the Weimar National Assembly of 1919 and the new republican flag
flag-germany-black-red-gold.scene: In a classical theatre turned assembly hall, delegates in dark suits sit beneath a huge flag of three horizontal bands hung across the stage.

flag-soviet-hammer-sickle.research_focus: the 1923 flag of the Soviet Union and Moscow in the early 1920s
flag-soviet-hammer-sickle.scene: A flag bearing a crossed hammer and sickle beneath a bordered star billows over the Kremlin walls on a winter day, a column of workers marching below.

flag-india-tricolour-adopted.research_focus: the Indian tricolour with the Ashoka Chakra, and Delhi in August 1947
flag-india-tricolour-adopted.scene: A great flag of three horizontal bands with a spoked wheel at its centre unfurls over a vast crowd in Delhi at dusk, no individual faces in focus.

flag-israel-adopted.research_focus: the 1948 flag of Israel and the tallit design it was based on
flag-israel-adopted.scene: A prayer shawl with its striped border lies folded on a table beside a newly sewn flag with two stripes and a hexagram, a window open behind them.

flag-china-five-star-raised.research_focus: Tiananmen Square on 1 October 1949 and the first raising of the five-star flag
flag-china-five-star-raised.scene: Seen from far behind a vast crowd, a flag with one large star and four small stars rises on a tall pole before the gate of Tiananmen, no individual figures recognisable.

flag-ghana-raised.research_focus: Accra on the night of 6 March 1957 and the new flag of Ghana with its black star
flag-ghana-raised.scene: At midnight in Accra, a flag with a five-pointed star on its central band climbs a floodlit pole while a dancing crowd fills the old polo ground, no recognisable leaders.

flag-nepal-double-pennant.research_focus: the flag of Nepal, its two stacked pennants with sun and moon, and the Kathmandu valley
flag-nepal-double-pennant.scene: A flag of two stacked pointed pennants, a crescent moon on the upper and a sun on the lower, flies from a pagoda roof against snowy Himalayan peaks.

flag-canada-maple-leaf.research_focus: the first raising of the Maple Leaf flag on Parliament Hill in Ottawa, 15 February 1965
flag-canada-maple-leaf.scene: On a snowy winter day, a flag with a single stylised maple leaf rises up the pole above the Peace Tower in Ottawa, a crowd in winter coats seen from behind.

flag-uae-raised.research_focus: Union House in Dubai on 2 December 1971 and the new UAE flag
flag-uae-raised.scene: Beside a low modern villa on the Dubai shore, a flag with a vertical band at the hoist and three horizontal bands rises on a white pole, robed figures watching from a distance.

flag-bangladesh-adopted.research_focus: the flag of Bangladesh, a disc on a field, and Dhaka in early 1972
flag-bangladesh-adopted.scene: A flag with a single disc set slightly toward the hoist flies over a river crowded with wooden boats near Dhaka, villagers on the bank looking up.

flag-zimbabwe-raised.research_focus: Rufaro Stadium in Salisbury at midnight on 17-18 April 1980 and the new flag of Zimbabwe
flag-zimbabwe-raised.scene: Under stadium floodlights at midnight, a flag with a triangle bearing a star and a carved stone bird rises above a packed and cheering crowd, no recognisable dignitaries.

flag-russia-tricolour-returns.research_focus: the defence of the Russian White House in Moscow in August 1991 and the tricolour
flag-russia-tricolour-returns.scene: On top of a barricaded tank outside a white government building in Moscow, a crowd of young people waves a huge flag of three horizontal bands, no recognisable politicians.

flag-south-africa-new.research_focus: the new South African flag of April 1994 with its horizontal Y
flag-south-africa-new.scene: A flag with a sideways Y shape splitting into two arms flies above a long line of voters snaking across a dusty township field at dawn, seen from behind.

flag-kosovo-unveiled.research_focus: Pristina in February 2008 and the flag of Kosovo with its map and six stars
flag-kosovo-unveiled.scene: In a snowy city square in Pristina, a crowd lifts a huge flag bearing the outline of a country beneath an arc of six stars, no recognisable faces.

flag-south-sudan-raised.research_focus: the independence ceremony in Juba on 9 July 2011 and the flag of South Sudan
flag-south-sudan-raised.scene: Under a hot sky in Juba, a flag with a triangle and a single star at the hoist rises on a tall pole above a sea of celebrating people, no recognisable leaders.
